title: Extras
description: Add-ons customers can book with a car

help.title: About extras
help.overview: Extras such as child seats, an additional driver or insurance cover are added to a booking.

sections.title: On this page
items: Per-day extras are charged for every rental day; per-rental extras once.
Deactivate an extra to stop offering it; existing bookings keep their price.
Reorder sets the order customers see on the website.

reorderDescription: Drag extras to change their order on the website.
